description: 50 separate pending five-stage independent source/linguistic/audio review packets. Links are unvisited research leads, NOT evidence.

english_definition_review.task: Independently consult a trustworthy dictionary for the exact selected sense and POS; record observed quotation-free paraphrase, date, reviewer and source. Reject wrong WordNet sense.

burmese_review.task: Independently review natural Myanmar gloss, register and English-sense alignment; record reviewer, date and evidence.

example_review.task: Independently check original example for grammar, natural collocation, exact sense and appropriateness.

cefr_review.task: Independently establish sense-specific CEFR tier using an actual observed level-tagged source; otherwise hold/re-tier.

audio_review.task: After editorial approval generate George and Emma recordings; listen to both and test physical iPhone Safari.

example_review.task: Independently check original example for grammar, natural collocation, exact sense and appropriateness.

cefr_review.task: Independently establish sense-specific CEFR tier using an actual observed level-tagged source; otherwise hold/re-tier.

audio_review.task: After editorial approval generate George and Emma recordings; listen to both and test physical iPhone Safari.
